**Build machines from components.** A Fieldframe machine is a **chassis** with up to six **modules** mounted on its faces. Modules share the chassis' internal item lanes, fluid reservoirs, RF buffer and control channels, so the arrangement of parts decides what the machine does.

Start with [[fieldframe:basics/chassis|the chassis]], then build [[fieldframe:basics/first_machine|your first machine]]. Use the [[fieldframe:basics/configurator|configurator]] to see exactly what every part is doing and why it might be blocked.

Fieldframe has **no pipes, cables or wireless links**. Machines exchange items, fluids and RF only with blocks they touch, through ports you mount on purpose. Other mods' pipes can connect to those ports normally.

**Keys:** press the Field Manual key (default **U**) while looking at a chassis face to jump straight to that module's page. In the manual: **/** search, **Backspace** back, **B** bookmark, **N** private note.
